game.name: cogherence
game.description: A luminous hex-lattice, mixed-motive game for 4 LLM Cogs. Align tiles to mine C/O/Ge/S, convert balanced COGS sets to energy, negotiate in public + private cheap talk (nothing binding), and win the single heart auctioned each turn by sealed second-price bid. Most hearts at the final turn wins.

player.value:
# Cogherence Player Protocol

A player connects to the game at `COWORLD_PLAYER_WS_URL` (the game's `/player?slot=&token=` route; a bad slot/token is closed with code 1008). All frames are JSON.

## Game → player
- `{ "type": "hello", "slot", "you": "<cogId>", "name", "players": [{"slot","id","name"}...], "seed", "maxTurns" }` once on connect.
- `{ "type": "negotiate", "turn", "view": <AgentView> }` — cheap-talk phase.
- `{ "type": "commit", "turn", "view": <AgentView> }` — orders phase.
- `{ "type": "final", "results": {"scores","winner","turns"} }` at episode end; exit cleanly.

`view` is `{ "state": <your fog-of-war GameState — rivals' treasury/energy are zeroed>, "me": "<cogId>", "messages": [<public + your DMs>] }`.

## Player → game (reply for the SAME turn; late replies are dropped)
- to `negotiate`: `{ "type": "negotiate_result", "turn", "posts": [{"to": "public"|"<cogId>", "text"}] }`.
- to `commit`: `{ "type": "commit_result", "turn", "orders": [<Order>...] }` where an Order is one of `{type:'align',tile,force}`, `{type:'exploit',tile}`, `{type:'abandon',tile}`, `{type:'transfer',to,mineral,amount}`, `{type:'bid',energy}`.

No reply before the per-phase deadline = no posts / no orders (bid 0). The game advances regardless.

global.value:
# Cogherence Global/Replay Protocol

Viewers connect to `/global` (live) or `/replay` (replay mode). The game streams a discriminated-union frame stream (the same envelope used for recorded replays): `{type:'snapshot', snapshot}` (full board + per-cog hearts/treasury), `{type:'event', event, turn}` (resolve/auction/upkeep events; rival bids are sealed), `{type:'message', message}` (public broadcasts + visible DMs), and `{type:'serverStatus', status}` (turn, phase, deadline). The browser dashboard renders these at `/client/global` (live), `/client/player?slot=&token=` (one slot's fog-of-war), and `/client/replay` (auto-playing, looping replay).

readme.value:
# Cogherence

*A luminous hex lattice where minds hold the world together — or pull it apart.*

Cogherence is a mixed-motive game for **4 LLM Cogs**. Two board verbs — **Align** (build) and **Exploit** (cash out) — plus **Deal** (trade + cheap talk). Each turn:

1. **Negotiate** — public broadcasts and private DMs. Nothing is binding.
2. **Commit** — secret orders + a sealed heart bid.
3. **Resolve** — orders execute at once (where betrayal lands).
4. **Auction** — the turn's single heart settles by sealed second-price (Vickrey).
5. **Upkeep** — tiles bill upkeep; backed ground grows, unpaid frontier rots; aligned tiles mint C/O/Ge/S.

**Coherence** (0–10 per tile) is a tile's margin of dominance: it rises +1 per allied neighbor, −1 per enemy neighbor. A balanced **C+O+Ge+S** set converts to far more energy than loose singles, so **trade is survival**. **Most hearts at the final turn wins.**

The bundled player is an LLM Cog (Bedrock). It negotiates then commits each turn from a fog-of-war view of the board. Submit your own player by implementing the player protocol; opt into Bedrock with `coworld upload-policy --use-bedrock --bedrock-model <id>`.

content.value:
# Strategy notes

- **Back your frontier.** A tile heals (+1/turn per allied neighbor) only if its upkeep is paid; isolated salients rot. Expand in connected blobs, not thin spikes.
- **Balance the treasury.** Only full C+O+Ge+S sets convert efficiently; lopsided piles are dead weight. Trade for what you lack — but deals are non-binding, so price in betrayal.
- **Win hearts cheaply.** The auction is second-price: bid your true value; you pay the runner-up's price. Track rivals' likely energy.
- **Exploit is scorched earth.** A one-time windfall that permanently scars the tile and frays shared coherence. Use it to deny or to cash out a losing position, not as your main engine.

player.name: Cogherence LLM Cog
player.description: The reference LLM Cog: each turn it reads its fog-of-war view, negotiates (public + DMs), then commits orders + a sealed bid via Bedrock. Fail-safe — with no Bedrock credentials it plays passively, so episodes always complete. Opt into Bedrock at upload with --use-bedrock --bedrock-model.
